content: Medicare provides reimbursement for Diabetes Self-Management Education and Support (DSMES) services, contingent upon the fulfillment of specific criteria. This reimbursement encompasses both in-person and virtual DSMES services, with virtual services receiving increased emphasis and coverage during the COVID-19 pandemic. Medicaid programs, as well as private insurance providers, are strongly encouraged to offer reimbursement for DSMES services. This is particularly important when these services are delivered through telehealth platforms, as this approach facilitates access for underserved and remote populations who may otherwise face barriers to care. Recent updates in healthcare policy underscore a dedicated effort to enhance the accessibility of DSMES services.
